costumes.name: Thief of Justice
costumes.description:
Miranda costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: A.C.P.U. will always be here to protect the citizens of the Ark.
You called? What do you need?
You call me over here for nothing? Can you please not do that?
I will continue to protect you, Commander!
You and Poli are the most important people in my life!
Excuse me... is the Commander here?

Where have you been, Commander?
I waited for your return!
We do have iron grate windows. Not sure how sturdy they are though.
Complaints keep piling into the police station. I just don't get it.
I'll make more effort! Wow! I'm full of power!
I'm growing stronger! I really am!
I feel like I'm on top of the world!
Err... Is someone in my position even allowed to accept this?
You are the best, Commander. I'm so happy.
I'll do everything I can to make your life easier, Commander.
Staying with you always gives me this feeling... I don't know how to describe it!
You have complete trust in me, don't you? And you're willing to rely on me? I'm so glad to hear that!
All right! I'm feeling it now!
Harder! Harder, I said! Yes, the power!
Guess I didn't work hard enough...

favorite.description: A token of gratitude for the young girl who tirelessly serves the citizens. It likely holds greater significance for her than anything else in the world.
